Grand Theft Auto V. A crime sandbox developed by Rockstar Games, released in 2013 and set in the sprawling fictional metropolis of Los Santos. You play as three protagonists—Michael, Franklin, and Trevor—whose personal arcs and motivations intersect across a branching narrative of crime and corruption. The game interweaves their stories through missions, heists, and open-world activities set in one of gaming's most detailed cities. It became a cultural touchstone, with both the single-player campaign and GTA Online, the multiplayer component launched alongside it, dominating sales and streaming for over a decade. The massive open city is divided into diverse districts, each with distinct architecture, NPCs, and activities from street racing to stock manipulation to scuba diving. A signature feature is the Heist mission format—multi-stage criminal operations where the planning phase determines what equipment and allies are available, affecting how you execute each job. The gameplay loop centers on driving, shooting, stealth, and exploration. Side activities include tennis, golf, yoga, and property investment that generates in-game income. The game features voice acting and mission design that mimic cinematic storytelling, accompanied by licensed music across multiple radio stations. GTA Online evolved into a persistent multiplayer sandbox with player properties, businesses, and continuous content updates, and it has generated billions in revenue. The game was criticized for its portrayal of violence and for GTA Online's shift toward monetization, but it was universally praised for its technical polish and sheer world detail.
